_comment: 1.0 items the wiki has not documented yet, surfaced from the game files.
The 1.0 release (2026-08-05) added items the wiki's Items table still
lacks as of 2026-08-08 — verified live: no Engagement Ring page exists and
the Cargo table is pre-1.0. The game files state these items outright, so
records are built from them: name, values, tags and recipes are the
game's own facts, `confidence: game_files`, and every wiki-only field
stays a gap until the wiki catches up (the weekly refresh will bring its
sprites and prose-derived facts when they exist).
Source for what 1.0 added: the official patch notes,
https://www.fieldsofmistria.com/post/fields-of-mistria-s-1-0-update-patch-notes-are-here
THIS IS AN ALLOWLIST, NOT A SYNC. The game ships 2,665 items and the
dataset deliberately does not mirror them all — most of the difference is
furniture (deferred wholesale) and internals. An id belongs here only
when a player would search for it. Ids are the game's own; a typo fails
the build because the builder throws on an id the game files do not have.
Not listed, deliberately: crystal_resonator_* (furniture — they arrive
with the furniture ingestion), date_photo_wedding and
engagement_ring_recipe_scroll (mementos/wrappers a player never hunts
for).
apiary and terrarium are the 1.0 production machines — craftable farm
objects (other/apiaries_and_terrariums.toml), not furniture. Listing them
ships their crafting recipes too: the recipes builder holds a recipe back
only while its output id is absent from the built items.
2026-08-14 sweep (v1.5.1): every id added below has a STATED source in
sources/game/ — a stores.json stock line (the carpenter sells the Seed
Maker, Forge, Crafting Station, Mini Mill, Perpetual Soup Pot, Level 1
Kitchen and every barn/coop/greenhouse blueprint; Hayden sells the four
animal toys; the general store sells Snow Peas seed), an unlocks.json
grant (the star brooch, the mini museum blueprint, and the eleven
ten-heart keepsakes given by their heart scenes), or a spawns.json rule
(unidentified_artifact, which the fished/dived artifact rules yield).
Judged OUT for having no stated source anywhere: cozy_kitchen and
adept_kitchen (bought as carpenter upgrade work, not as stock),
big_egg (other/unreviewed_new_items.toml — the file name is the verdict),
harvest_day_pie, soup_of_the_day and soup_of_the_day_gold (served in
scenes, never granted), lopsided_animal, ruins_tablet_rubbing,
ryis_lumber, balors_crate, unusual_seed and construction_fence.
caldarus_dragonsworn_statue and seridias_dragonsworn_armor are named
after veiled characters, so vocab/spoilers.json stamps them.
